title: Zero-sum slice lab and commitment-fence rules
creator: Maya Chen
description: Define an operational playbook and lightweight automation for making deterministic scope cuts inside a fixed-cycle budget. Problem: when a cycle is fully committed, teams still receive inbound requests or new priorities; we need a repeatable zero-sum process for trimming work, assigning role-level shadowing, and locking in a commitment fence so downstream consumers (sales, SRE, infra) know what will ship. This ticket captures the playbook, gating rules, metrics to monitor, and minimal console UX changes to expose the commitment fence to stakeholders.
